_comment: Copy to ~/.agent-multiplier/config.json and put your own categories. Each one: name, fragments of the working directory that identify it (first category that matches wins), a definition for the page, and the kind of work: delegable, creative, coordination or meeting.

coordination.name: Coordination
coordination.definition: Sessions opened at the root of your work, with no repo: email, chat, analysis.

meeting.name: Questions during meetings
meeting.definition: Every input written during a calendar meeting with other attendees.
